quest.title: Mystery of the Arcadian Ruins
quest.description: According to Kaeya, his pirate grandfather left behind a treasured sword that has been buried in the Lost Arcadian Ruins. To prevent it from falling into the wrong hands, you search high and low for intelligence regarding the ruins.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Mora x3225, Wanderer's Advice x8, Fine Enhancement Ore x3

talks.objective: Meet with the informant at the designated location

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Look, {NICKNAME}! She's in trouble!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Forget about the informant. Let's save her!

talks.objective: Defeat the opponents attacking the informant

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Why is this happening to me? I shouldn't have helped <color=#00E1FFFF>him</color>...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Him, who?

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Thanks so much for saving me! You're far more reliable than those Favonius guys.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #It's nothing. {M#He}{F#She}'s a traveler, {M#he}{F#she} has to deal with stuff like this all the time.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Traveler? I've heard stories about you. I didn't think I'd be saved by <color=#00E1FFFF>the one I'm here to meet</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, so you're the...

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Hahaha... I didn't know how I could pay you back initially, but now, I think I'll just give you the intel for free.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: People in our circle know how important the network is.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Well, you did save my life.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But... it's lucky for Kaeya, isn't it? He's supposed to pay for the intel...

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Listen well then, the intel on the Arcadian Ruins...

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: "Three six-armed giants reside in the city in the lake. Two guard the statue, one, the treasure."

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: There's also this map that came with it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So the clue is more like a riddle...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Well, should be a piece of cake for ya, right {NICKNAME}? Paimon'll leave it to you then!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, if you can't solve it, we can ask Kaeya. He seems like a nerd too.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: I'll leave you the intel so you can review it at any time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Three six-armed giants reside in the city in the lake. Two guard the statue, one, the treasure."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What does that mean? If you don't wanna ask Kaeya, you better figure it out!

talks.objective: Find the location of the buried treasure

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, lemme see what's inside!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "She doesn't love him at all. The passion rushing through the clear spring is just a front. When she's cold and alone, her true heart is revealed."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's another map.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: More riddles?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's dizzy already. Oh, no! Paimon used up all her brain juice!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You never had any to begin with...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon'll let you have all the fun. Or, you could get Kaeya to help.

talks.objective: Disappears after controlling Paimon to talk
Solve the mystery (Go to Kaeya at the Knights of Favonius HQ for a hint)

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}! You're back! Looks like you got the intel.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yes and no. It's a lot more complicated than that.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Three six-armed giants reside in the city in the lake. Two guard the statue, one, the treasure." What do you make of it?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Riddles? How quaint. Let me think...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: "City in the lake" is clearly Mondstadt... As for the Six-Armed Giants... Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Crabs?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Giant crabs!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Aside from asking just where we would find giant crabs...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Crabs have eight legs, not six...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The windmills, then?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Should be... the windmills?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Hey! That's smart!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: A windmill has six blades... It fits.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow! That makes sense!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: So, out of the three windmills, two are close to the statue...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: The other one is guarding...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh! Ooh! This one Paimon knows! The treasure!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Hehehe... Let's hope it's really that simple.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Come on, {NICKNAME}! Let's go take a look around that windmill!

talks.objective: Look for the location in the riddle

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: The location is in the Whispering Woods — you haven't forgotten, right?

talks.objective: Find the location of the buried treasure

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, to a genius like me, this is nothing. Take a look at this map!

talks.objective: Solve the mystery (Go to Kaeya at the Knights of Favonius HQ for a hint)

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: "She doesn't love him at all. The passion rushing through the clear spring is just a front. When she's cold and alone, her true heart is revealed."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Any idea what that means?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Is this some page stripped from a love novel that you just happened to find?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, so it's not a clue. No wonder someone as clever as Paimon wasn't able to get it.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Hahaha... I'm just joking.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph... Take this more seriously, Kaeya!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Haha, this riddle is hard to figure out. Clear spring... Is it referring to Springvale?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: "Passion rushing through the clear spring..." So when does passion rush through a clear spring?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: And the "heart" of the waterfall must refer to the cliff on the left side of the waterfall. I noticed it once when I was out on patrol in the area.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: The ending, "cold and alone," probably has something to do with Cryo, which can be controlled by a Vision.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: You should probably <color=#00E1FFFF>take someone who can manipulate Cryo with you</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thanks for the help, Kaeya.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: It's nothing. If a Knight of Favonius couldn't even answer a riddle, how could we be trusted to solve criminal mysteries?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go take a look in Springvale. We'll leave you to your "criminal mysteries"!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Erm...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, wait... Leave you to SOLVING your criminal mysteries!

talks.objective: Look for the location in the riddle

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: If I'm right, the location described by the clue is the windmill the furthest away from the statue... I'm not completely certain though.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Take a look around the waterfall near Springvale. Remember to bring a friend who can manipulate Cryo. Huh? Oh... Me?

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: "Three six-armed giants reside in the city in the lake. Two guard the statue, one, the treasure." Got it?
